title: Welcome to Microsoft LaunchMate 2026 Cohort! 🚀
body: We are thrilled to welcome our newest engineers to the Redmond & Global engineering hub. Please complete Day-1 checklist items and join the Virtual Orientation.

title: Launch Mate Live Test
body: This is a live end-to-end test of the SendGrid email notification system. If you received this email, the announcement broadcast pipeline is fully operational!

title: Launch Mate is LIVE!
body: The AI Onboarding Assistant email notification pipeline is now fully operational. This announcement was broadcast via SendGrid to all registered employees in real-time.

title: 📢 Announcement from Maanvi
body: Welcome to Launch Mate! Please verify your onboarding tasks and let me know if you need any assistance.

title: Important Onboarding Checkpoint
body: Please complete your IT security setup and NHS / health benefits confirmation by end of day. If you need any assistance, reach out directly in #it-support or message HR partner Maanvi.
